subject: Request: Non-standard SLO & Remedy for EdgeWave - Exec Approval Needed
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeWave Contracts <contracts@edgewave.io>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: EdgeWave: SLO/Remedy ask + commercial concession (DW-4721)

Kimberly / Laura,

Following up on yesterday's discovery call with EdgeWave (Anya and Marcus Green copied), they want a nondisclosure friendly SOW but also have a hard requirement: 99.95% monthly uptime target for inference endpoints, and they want the remedy to be capped service credits rather than the standard rolling-window SLA we offer.

Key points from the customer: 
- Target: 99.95% monthly availability (current Redwood standard: 99.9% for this tier)
- Remedy: they ask for up to 10% monthly service credit (we normally cap at 5% for this tier)
- Commercial ask: 20% first-year onboarding discount tied to committed usage (annualized)

They are comfortable with 'dedicated capacity' and want private deployment options. Security/compliance is fine. They will sign quickly if we accept the SLO/remedy composition + discount. They flagged procurement timelines (legal wants final terms by 12/10).

Attached: edgewave_sow_v3.pdf, proposed_slo_table.xlsx, deal_summary_DW-4721.docx

Can we get dealdesk / exec signoff for: (a) one-off SLO adjustment to 99.95% for the first 12 months with a 10% credit cap, and (b) 20% onboarding discount? If not, what would be the counter we can offer to keep the deal on the table?

Thanks,
Vivek
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: EdgeWave: SLO/Remedy ask + commercial concession (DW-4721) - Requesting Exec Approval

Forwarding Vivek's summary and attachments to loop in dealdesk/finance for decisioning.

High-level ask we need an approval for:
1) SLO: increase to 99.95% monthly availability for dedicated inference endpoints for EdgeWave (12-month term).
2) Remedy: allow a one-time negotiated cap of up to 10% monthly service credit (our baseline for this tier is 5%).
3) Commercial: 20% onboarding discount applied across first-year committed revenue.

Operational considerations: EdgeWave will require private VPC deployment and dedicated capacity, which reduces multi-tenant risk and should limit exposure, but 10% credit is above our standard cap. They are a mid-market but strategic in the telco segment; getting them as a reference opens a channel. Vivek notes legal timeline 12/10.

Please review and advise: - Marcus, do you sign off on the 10% remedy cap and 20% discount? - Laura, any additional guardrails (time-bound reviews, monitoring hooks, playbooks) we should require in the SOW?

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWave: SLO/Remedy ask + commercial concession (DW-4721)

Kimberly / Team,

I ran a quick risk assessment with CS and Product. Notes and suggested controls below: 

Risk & mitigation: 
- Increased credit cap (10%): acceptable only if we: (a) limit to the first 12 months, (b) require a joint runbook and quarterly operational review, and (c) reserve the right to revert the remedy to standard caps after the first 90 days if we observe repeated Class C incidents.
- 99.95% SLO: since they will take Dedicated, this is technically achievable. We should require the customer to accept a narrower definition of "availability" (e.g., exclude scheduled maintenance windows with 72h notice and customer-configured latency thresholds).
- Discount: 20% onboarding OK if we secure a 12-month commit and an auto-renew clause; prefer to tier discount to usage ramp (10% first quarter, 20% after 3 months if committed usage met).

Operational guardrails to include in SOW: 
- Monthly tokenized availability report (shared dashboard link), auto-notifications before credit calculation windows, and a 6-month executive review clause.
- Legal: include explicit cap language and service credit calculation example.

From a commercial perspective I can recommend approving the SLO tweak and the discount with the controls above. Marcus, can you confirm finance is comfortable with the conditional credit cap?

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success (acting Head of Product Ops for SLOs)
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeWave: SLO/Remedy ask + commercial concession (DW-4721) - APPROVED w/ conditions

Kimberly / Team,

Approval granted with the following finance conditions: 
1) Approve one-time SLO adjustment to 99.95% for 12 months.
2) Approve service credit cap at 10% for the first 12 months, provided the operational guardrails Laura outlined are included in the SOW and Viva's team (Ops) signs the runbook within 14 days of contract execution.
3) Approve onboarding discount up to 20% contingent on: (a) a minimum 12-month committed ARR, (b) a usage ramp milestone after month 3 as Laura suggested (we'll pay the 20% only if the ramp is hit; otherwise default to 10%), and (c) finance reserves the right to structure the discount as a credit applied over the first 6 invoices to preserve cashflow.

Also require a 6-month pricing & SLO review clause (mutual) and a clear termination for convenience notice (60 days) for Redwood if repeated incidents occur.

Vivek: you can communicate to EdgeWave that we have conditional approval and ask Legal to prepare the SOW update. Get Legal cc'd and Ops to agree to the runbook timeline.

Marcus Lin
VP Finance, Revenue Operations
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0142
